plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-15 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). Program page states the pathways are for catalog year 2026-2027 and the map is headed 'Mechanized Agriculture Associate of Science map for 2026-2027'. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. The program has TWO pathways; this plan transcribes the first/default 'to CSU' (CSU Bakersfield) pathway in full. The second pathway, 'to Degree' (60-61.5 units, 4 terms), is a second GE pattern for the same credential, not a separate degree, and is not collected as a separate plan. The transcribed map prints the degree total as a range, 61-62.5 units, and term totals as 15-16.5 / 15 / 16 / 15. The only ranged slot is Term 1 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5). Per the standing minimum-credit convention it is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 61 units. General-education slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. The map prints a 'Prerequisites' flag on MCAG B14 and MCAG B12 but does not print the specific prerequisite courses, so no prereqs are recorded. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. The map page states verbatim: 'Program maps are for reference only. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan or visit CSU Transfer Planner for more options.'
